data.title: 阿米娅 · 暴风雨夜的毛毯相偎
data.description: 本舰穿行在荒野风暴中的漆黑夜晚，颠簸与雷鸣让人无法入眠。休息室里，两人同披一条宽大的厚毛毯并肩而坐。阿米娅双手捧着刚泡好的热红茶，白汽蒸腾间，她微微侧过身子，将头轻轻靠在博士的肩上，任由外面的风暴如何喧嚣，心底只有安宁。
data.action: wrapped in shared blanket, resting head on shoulder, steaming tea
data.lighting: soft dim warm ceiling light against stormy window
data.mood: heartwarming safe shelter from the world
data.promptProse: Sharing a warm wool blanket inside the lounge during a violent wasteland sandstorm, Amiya rests her head on the Doctor's shoulder. She holds a steaming porcelain teacup with both hands, finding complete sanctuary and serenity.
data.animaCaption: Amiya resting peacefully on the Doctor's shoulder under a shared blanket.
